user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Web content surfaced in ChatGPT search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in site robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Content used in training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in site robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-prompted visits and interactions via GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content potentially contributing to generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content crawled for AI model development.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.scope: Content retrieved in response to user-initiated queries and searches.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds information for building Google's search indexes, product crawls, and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images, logos, and favicons for Google products.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and image features in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for Googlebot-Image or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content for video-related Google Search features.
user_agents.scope: Affects video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for Googlebot-Video or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google News.
user_agents.scope: Affects the Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for Googlebot-News or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: Affects all surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for user-agent Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Crawls for Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Affects Search testing tools in Search Console; has no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible content, such as for internal research.
user_agents.scope: Used by various product teams; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for user-agent GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Used by product teams for image URLs; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Used by product teams for video URLs; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Executes site owner-requested crawls for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Affects crawls requested for building Vertex AI Agents; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training future Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.scope: Controls Gemini model training and grounding; does not impact Google Search inclusion or ranking.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for user-agent Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features in Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: General search web crawling and rendering across the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of website content to train Apple's generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; controls training use of data crawled by Applebot.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays info like title, description, and thumbnail image when links are shared.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow in robots.txt; might bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance and link content in Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Improving advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web to train foundation AI models or index content directly.
user_agents.scope: Training foundation AI models or improving products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and evaluates agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Helping AI navigate websites to complete tasks for users.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because it performs fetches requested by the user.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for improving products, services, and training Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives or page-level noarchive, noindex, or none meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content eligible to appear in Amazon search experiences such as Alexa.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt directives or page-level noindex or none meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information to answer queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web information fetched on a user's behalf for queries.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to produce an open dataset for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: A randomly selected subset of publicly accessible web pages across the Internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Specify User-agent: CCBot with Disallow in robots.txt or use opt-out registry.
